readme: # SDV ## Overview The Synthetic Data Vault (SDV) is a Python library designed to be your one-stop shop for creating tabular synthetic data. It is available to the public under the Business Source License. Additional plans are also available. ## Highlights - **SINGLE TABLE DATA** - GaussianCopulaSynthesizer , CTGANSynthesizer , TVAESynthesizer. - **MULTI TABLE DATA** - DayZSynthesizer , HMASynthesizer, HSASynthesizer. - **SEQUENTIAL DATA** ## Tools Used - Python - Pandas - NumPy - Jupyter Notebooks - Google Colab
